title: Juicy Stuffed Grapevine Leaves Dolmades
description: Fresh grapevine leaves stuffed with a sweet and tangy filling of tamarind pulp, nuka-pickle, and spices, served in a salt block.
instructions: Soak grapevine leaves in water for 1 hour.
Sauté chopped onion and nuka-pickle in a pan until softened.
Add tamarind pulp, rice, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Drain and chop grapevine leaves, then add them to the pan and stir-fry for another minute.
Wet the grapevine leaves with lemon juice and fill the center of each leaf with the tamarind mixture.
Roll the leaves into neat packages and place them seam-side down in a salt block.
Cover the salt block with a plate and weigh it down with a heavy object.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
